scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @pero/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:host && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:macos-native: node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release --locked -p pero-host && node scripts/cargo.mjs +nightly-2026-10-28 build --release --locked -p pero-ui --features native --bin pero-native && node scripts/build/native-preview.mjs
scripts.package:macos: npm run build:apps && PERO_BUILD_RELEASE=1 node scripts/build/wasm.mjs && node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release --locked -p pero-host && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/build/macos-package.mjs
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/codegen/theme.mjs --check && node scripts/check/locales.mjs && node scripts/codegen/contracts.mjs --check
scripts.test: node scripts/cargo.mjs test -p pero-contracts -p pero-runtime -p pero-host -p pero-ui -p pero-worker
scripts.test:connector:live: cd server && PERO_DESKTOP_E2E=1 PERO_CONNECTOR_LIVE=1 go test -count=1 -run '^TestDesktopConnectorSources$' ./internal/httpapi -v
